verdict.rationale: Adyen documents role-scoped API credentials. Each credential carries permission roles, and you can create multiple credentials, including ones restricted to a single merchant account, for finer least-privilege control. Its MCP server docs tie agent access to a specific role list assigned per credential, and its tool-subsetting advice limits what the agent can call. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence of agent-specific controls such as short-lived or expiring tokens and documented rotation or revocation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Roles: Permissions that define what the credential is allowed to do
Credentials created on a merchant account can only access that merchant account.
You can also create multiple API credentials to improve security and control access.
